highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves native reliability, rendering performance, and support across Apple, Android, Linux, and WebAssembly.
highlights_body: It corrects native data handling and stream lifetime issues, reduces managed and HarfBuzz allocation overhead, and updates bundled platform components for current toolchains.

bullets.lead: Native data creation handles C strings safely
bullets.detail: SKData creation now determines the native string length correctly and writes directly into the resulting data, avoiding reads beyond the source buffer.
Streams that use a front buffer no longer retain data after it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows the display refresh
bullets.detail: Texture rendering is synchronized with display refresh to provide smoother Android output.

bullets.lead: Pixel and text shaping paths allocate less
bullets.detail: Managed image pixel copies, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature-string handling reduce temporary allocation work.
Apple native packages now target the current supported deployment baselines.

bullets.lead: Linux and WebAssembly native assets updated
bullets.detail: Linux packages bind the bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, while WebAssembly static libraries include the emdawnwebgpu implementation.

bullets.lead: Windows native builds use current tooling
bullets.detail: Windows packages are built with Visual Studio 2026 and a refreshed ANGLE Chromium revision.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bundled HarfBuzz binding improvements for Linux and more reliable Blazor CPU sample rendering tests
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Included the emdawnwebgpu implementation in WebAssembly static libraries
